blocks.content: The Parliamentary Standing Committee on Science and Technology, Environment, Forests and Climate Change presented its 412th report on forest fires in the Himalayan region in August 2026. The report covered forest-fire causes, mitigation measures, pine-needle management, biomass use, satellite support, and disaster-response capacity in the Western Himalayas.

items: Chir Pine is a Himalayan conifer species associated with dry needle litter and recurring forest-fire risk.
Co-firing is the use of biomass or other fuels together with coal in thermal power stations.
The National Disaster Response Force was constituted under the Disaster Management Act, 2005.
The Forest Research Institute is located in Dehradun and functions under the Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education.
